name: vref
__comment_why__: Added 2026-07-07 (PMIC expansion). 'Voltage References?' matches both the plural buckets and PMIC's singular 'Voltage Reference' ≈ 2.1k in-stock parts (TL431 country). Aliases verified against raw-attrs.
columns: __comment_vout__: adjustable shunts publish a range ('2.5V~36V') → both bounds;
fixed refs give a single value (min = max).
__comment_accuracy__: initial accuracy, stored as a fraction (±0.4% → 0.004).
percent kind understands ppm). Filter e.g. tempco_frac <= 50ppm as 5e-05.
__comment_ikmin__: shunt-only spec — minimum cathode current for regulation
('1mA' for a TL431): sets the bias-resistor budget. NULL for series refs.
